lines.en: Slyly gliding.
Black shadow glides over the ground.
Slowly moving silhouette.
Moving silently.
Creeping in the darkness.
Shadow flows like ink.
Unsteady black shadow.
Shadow slides on the ground.
A whisp of black smoke in the dark.
Moving silently forward.

lines.zh: 蒲公英在颤抖，我靠近了。
lines.en: The dandelion trembles as I draw near.
I walk where your sanity cracks.
Hiding in the darkness.
Black shadow standing still.
Moving silently around.
Silently waiting in the shadows.
Shadow隐匿 in the night.
Waiting silently for an opportunity.
Black shadow silently observing.
Silently waiting in the dark.
Hiding in the darkness.
Quietly hiding in the shadows.
Your pills cannot hold my shadow down.
The dandelion in the corner dims.
The more you hallucinate, the clearer I become.
I wait until your pills run out.
Watching your every move.
Staring at your figure.
Watchful gaze on you.
Staring at you with piercing eyes.
Watching your every move closely.
Spying on your movements.
Fixing you with a stare.
Staring at you for an opening.

lines.zh: 注视着你的每一个动作.
lines.en: Watching your every action.
Do not stare at my face too long.
I watch you count your pills.
I am in the corner of your eye.
I get closer each time you look. Do not blink.

lines.zh: 你的阴影刚刚动了一下。
lines.en: Your shadow just moved on its own.
An overdose will not help you.
I remember every nightmare of yours.
You can no longer tell me apart.
I look at you through your own eyes.
Your shadow turns to look for you.
Stop counting dandelions and look at me.
Shadows fade, strength wanes.
Darkness, I stumble.
Black shadows seep from wounds.
Strength fades, vision blurs.
Darkness consumes me.
Shadow servant摇摇欲坠。
My shadow's fading and I can't grip the ground.
Every step is a struggle.
Weak, I can barely stand.
Too much light; my shape comes apart.
The light on you won't scare me.

lines.zh: 我这一种形态，最不喜欢光。
lines.en: Of my three shapes, this one hates light most.
Night is my domain.
Are you dreaming?
Your shadow is my food.

lines.zh: 影子里的第三种模样，就是我。
lines.en: The third shape in the shadow is me.

lines.zh: 越暗的地方，我站得越直。
lines.en: The darker it gets, the taller I stand.
Don't hurt me with light.
You won't go far.
Your shadow will soon disappear.

lines.zh: 你蹭到我的肩，皮肤发冷。
lines.en: You brush my shoulder; your skin goes cold.

lines.zh: 不要碰我，否则你会后悔。
lines.en: Don't touch me, or you'll regret it.
My touch will unsettle you.

lines.zh: 小心，我的影子会缠住你。
lines.en: Be careful, my shadow will ensnare you.
You're getting too close.

lines.zh: 不要靠近我，否则你会后悔。
lines.en: Don't come closer, or you'll regret it.
My shadow will consume you.
Don't touch me, or you'll get hurt.

lines.zh: 保持距离，否则你会受伤。
lines.en: Keep your distance, or you'll be hurt.
Come closer, and you'll regret it
Find a better partner.
I'll choose better.
You don't want me.
Find a more suitable one.
I won't satisfy you.
You won't like me.
I'll find a better one.
Find a more suitable one.
You don't deserve me.
Find a better partner.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地靠近你，漆黑如墨。
lines.en: It approaches silently, black as ink.

lines.zh: 它的影子似乎在吸取你的生命力。
lines.en: Its shadow seems to drain your vitality.

lines.zh: 它蜷缩成一团，试图不被发现。
lines.en: It crouches, trying to avoid notice.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛反射着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with an eerie light.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地滑过地面。
lines.en: It glides silently across the ground.

lines.zh: 它的触感冰冷，几乎透明。
lines.en: Its touch is cold and nearly transparent.

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意从它身上散发。
lines.en: A chill emanates from its body.

lines.zh: 它似乎能预测你的每一个动作。
lines.en: It seems to predict every move you make.

lines.zh: 它慢慢地向你逼近，无声无息。
lines.en: It creeps towards you, silently.

lines.zh: 它的身体在黑暗中若隐若现。
lines.en: Its body flickers in the darkness.

lines.zh: 你踩灭灯的那一刻，我到了。
lines.en: The moment you put out the light, I arrive.
It approaches quietly, ready to hunt.

lines.zh: 它锁定你的位置，准备攻击。
lines.en: It locks onto your position, ready to strike.
Its gaze locks onto you.

lines.zh: 你感到它那冰冷的目光。
lines.en: You feel its cold gaze.

lines.zh: 它悄无声息地接近你的位置。
lines.en: It approaches your position silently.

lines.zh: 它的身体逐渐变得模糊。
lines.en: Its body fades gradually.
It prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 它的影子似乎在寻找弱点。
lines.en: Its shadow searches for weaknesses.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪耀着不祥的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes shine with an ominous glow.
Your sanity shattered into shadows.
I have chosen you as my host.
The shadow of your past has come for you.
There is nowhere left to hide.
This time I am no illusion.
Your fear gives me shape.

lines.zh: 它的触角缠绕在你身上。
lines.en: Its tentacles wrap around you.
It uses shadows to conceal itself.
It tries to grab you.
It extends cold hands towards you.
Its shadow tries to envelop you.

lines.zh: 它慢慢接近，试图攻击你。
lines.en: It approaches slowly, trying to attack you.

lines.zh: 我在等你先眨眼，就现在。
lines.en: I wait for you to blink. Now.
It tries to drag you into the shadow.
It tries to contain you.

lines.zh: 它的影子试图把你吞噬。
lines.en: Its shadow tries to consume you.
Your medicine wore off. I am still here.
I have pinned your shadow down.

lines.zh: 第三只手，抓住你的肩膀。
lines.en: A third hand closes on your shoulder.
I cling to the back of your neck.
The footsteps you hear are mine.
There is no exit in this dark.
I press to the wall and listen to you breathe.
Your shadow surrendered first.
I have swallowed your name.
You have forgotten how to run.
Sssss, Shadow strike!
Gotcha, and I’ll devour you.

lines.zh: 黑暗之力，注入你的灵魂！
lines.en: Darkness flows, into your soul.

lines.zh: 你触碰到我的影子，便难逃此劫！
lines.en: Your touch brings you closer to darkness.

lines.zh: 我的影子就是我的武器！
lines.en: My shadow is my weapon.
Darkness, consume their life!

lines.zh: 被我的影子包围，你将灭亡！
lines.en: Surrounded by my shadow, you will die.

lines.zh: 吞噬他们的灵魂，壮大我！
lines.en: Devour their souls, and grow stronger.
Shadow, become the slaughter.
You are my meal, eat up!
Sanity broke, and I have you.
This blow comes from the shadow.
Your tablets cannot save you now.
I drag you back into the night.
Fear enters you. Do not struggle.
The shadow bites your ankle.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，新的影子仆从诞生！
lines.en: A new Shadowchman spawns in the darkness!
A new threat, a new shadow!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的呼唤，召唤新仆从！
lines.en: A call in the dark, summon a new servant!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，影子仆从的低语！
lines.en: A whisper of the Shadowchman in the dark!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的存在，新的影子！
lines.en: A presence in the dark, a new shadow!
A new shadow, a new challenge!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，一个新的影子仆从！
lines.en: A new Shadowchman in the dark!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的低语，召唤新的影子！
lines.en: A dark whisper, summon a new shadow!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，新的影子仆从出现！
lines.en: A new Shadowchman appears in the dark!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的新生命，新的影子！
lines.en: A new life in the dark, a new shadow!
Your sanity bottoms out, and I take form.
The dandelion withered. I have come.
I crawl out of your nightmares.
The hallucination fades. I remain.
The third shadow stands here.
Your past sent me.
The dark curdles into my shape.
The pill bottle is empty. Here I am.
The shadow in the corner stands up.
I never truly left.
Flames burn my shadow.
Falls into darkness.
Water distorts my shadow.
Explosion rips my shadow.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，留下一个黑洞。
lines.en: The arrow passes through, leaving a black hole.
Magic melts me.

lines.zh: 第三种形态也撑不住了。
lines.en: Even my third form is failing.
Lightning strikes me.

lines.zh: 我的第三形态也散成影了。
lines.en: My third form scatters into shadow too.
